verdict.rationale: RevenueCat ships native dashboard charts of subscription metrics that are generated from purchase data stored in RevenueCat itself, not from an external BI export. The evidence explicitly names lifetime value charting and MRR (via the Rico assistant), but churn and cohort retention are never named. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of churn and cohort retention charts, any independent or hands-on corroboration of metric accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I get MRR, churn, cohort retention, and LTV analytics computed from the billing source of truth, not a bolted-on BI export

citations.quote: RevenueCat charts allow you to understand your user base with key subscription specific metrics, filters, and segments.
Charts are generated from purchase data saved in RevenueCat and work independently from any in-app usage.
See customer transaction histories, chart lifetime value, and grant promotional subscriptions.
Allows monetization metrics and charts to be filtered and segmented by acquisition source
